_doc: COVERAGE-2026-09-08. THE LIST OF WHAT THE SOCCER BOARD COVERS. It exists because the coverage was never written down: it lived in fixtures.json league labels, in CUPSCOPE-2026-09-01's admission rule, in the MLS/ASA wiring, and in a UCL_PO entry in soccer_mock's fallback dict. Nothing enumerated it, so 'is there a board today?' was answered from memory -- and on 2026-09-08 that answer was wrong three times in one hour: it missed MLS, then the Champions League, then the EFL Cup second round that CUPSCOPE had scoped a week earlier BY DATE AND BY EVENT ID. Read this file, do not recall it. slate_scan.js turns it into the day's fixture list.

core._doc: The five divisions Understat covers. Always admitted, no gate. These also DEFINE the gate: slate_scan builds the eligible-club set from these leagues' own scoreboards, so it stays correct through promotion and relegation with nothing to hand-edit.

open._doc: Covered in full, with its own xG source. MLS xG comes from American Soccer Analysis (ASAXG-2026-08-31, soccer_asa.js), not Understat, and XGMODEL-PARITY-2026-08-31 measured the two models to within 0.7-2.4% -- an order of magnitude tighter than the Serie A to EPL spread ONEPOOL already pools. No gate. ⚠️ An MLS card is ET-dated: it kicks 23:30Z-02:30Z, so half of it falls on the NEXT UTC day. Key the slate to the ET date or et_min's nightcap flag breaks.

gated._doc: Admitted PER TIE under CUPSCOPE-2026-09-01: at least one side must play in a `core` league, AND the fixture's oddschecker /winner page must actually render an Anytime Goalscorer section. The first half is what slate_scan checks; the second can only be checked on the page and is the scraper's job. Rationale, measured: a tie with one top-flight side joins xG at 73-87%, at or above the 79% a normal league board manages; two lower-division sides collapse to 27%, and at 27% edge_z=0 means 'average' rather than 'unknown', so an unmodelled forward outranks a real one whose xG is genuinely below average. That is a price ranking wearing a model's clothes.

_slugtraps._doc: oddschecker slugs that 200 and look right but are not. Check the FINAL url, not the status code. MLSSLUG-2026-09-18 added the three MLS entries after the first MLS tie in nine days cost three navigations to find; the working path is football/world/usa/mls/<home>-v-<away>/winner, reachable from football/leagues-cups.
_slugtraps.english/carabao-cup: silently redirects to the Premier League page
_slugtraps.english/league-cup: silently redirects to the Premier League page
_slugtraps.football/usa/mls: silently redirects to /football -- MLS lives under football/world/usa/mls
_slugtraps.football/usa/major-league-soccer: same redirect to /football; there is no country-level usa path
_slugtraps.us/soccer/mls: the US site RENDERS the fixture and has no Anytime Goalscorer section at all -- 19 market sections, none of them this one. The page looks right, which is the trap: a scraper finds zero wrappers and reports an empty card rather than a wrong URL. Team slugs also differ from ESPN's (new-york-city-fc-v-new-york-red-bulls vs ESPN's Red Bull New York), so the fixtures.json key is built from ESPN and only the URL comes from here.

intl._doc: INTL-2026-09-22. National-team football. Admitted at SCAN as 'worth opening' and gated for real downstream, because neither existing gate can be evaluated for a country. CUPSCOPE asks 'does one side play in a core league?' against ESPN club ids -- a national team has none, so the question has no answer rather than a negative one. The gate that does apply is JOINGATE-2026-09-22 in soccer_mock.py: the fixture's own xG join rate, measured against the names the book actually priced. Measured 2026-09-22 (claude/internationals-feasibility-2026-09-22): Netherlands v Germany joins 80%, which is the exact MEDIAN of 263 club fixtures on the 23 committed slates -- and its three misses are Eredivisie men, invisible to any nation-tier allowlist. ⚠️ THE BOOK IS THE FIRST GATE AND IT IS FREE: on the 09-24 matchday, Netherlands v Germany and Portugal v Wales carried a 15-name Anytime Goalscorer market, while Andorra v Malta and Kosovo v Republic of Ireland carried NO AGS section at all out of 27 markets. The bottom of the international spectrum excludes itself at the source. ⚠️ Measured two days out, so an absent market may still post -- re-scan on the morning of the slate, never pre-judge from a table. ⚠️ oddschecker slugs these /football/uefa-nations-league/<home>-v-<away>/winner -- there is NO /international/ segment; that path 404s. Find a fixture page in sitemap.xml, not the nav. ⚠️ No team sheets: status never reaches 'confirmed', so an international slate freezes on LOCK_ON_KICKOFF (KICKLOCK-2026-09-20), the football rule, not CONFLOCK.
